annotation.bound_parties_text: The working paper only proposes possible recommendations that High Contracting Parties could agree to; it binds no one itself.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: High Contracting Parties could agree on a set of principles, policies and measures for the design, development and use of lethal weapons systems featuring autonomy.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: The future normative and operational framework should apply to lethal autonomous weapons systems only
